notes.title: A Message from the IFU, Leveling and Skills, Side Missions and more!
notes.content:
[h1]We added some new stuff:[/h1] 
[list]
[*] We implemented a new Level System, through which you gain EXP for finding and correctly identifying the Ghost.
[*] You now gain a Skill Point every 5 Levels, starting at Level 5, which you can use to buy Skills via the Skill Tree Menu in the Lobby (Default Key: T)
[*] We also simultaneously implemented Side Missions, which you can complete for extra EXP.
[*] You can find these Side Missions on the Monitor, once you started your Round.
[*] You can now get an EMF 3, should the Ghost interact with Doors or Lightswitches
[*] We added a new Message concerning our Ship Map, which is currently unavailable
[/list]
[h1]We also fixed a lot of stuff including:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer: Player could not leave properly
[*] Multiplayer: Player did not connect properly
[*] Multiplayer: Position of Items were not correct trough the network
[*] Multiplayer: Leveling System did not work as it should
[*] Multiplayer: Name and Data from Ghost are now synced in all Journals
[*] Multiplayer: Improved mechanic for Item Placement
[*] Multiplayer: Fixed the Problem with the Skip Button during Mission Summary
[*] Multiplayer: Fixed the Lobby Code not being visible when starting a second Round
[*] Multiplayer: Fixed a bug where the Client saw more than one Witchfires
[*] Multiplayer: Removed the surplus Witchfires
[*] Multiplayer: Fixed a Bug that made Fingerprints unable to be made visible
[*] Multiplayer: Lights from Flashlights were sometimes inverted
[*] Multiplayer: Fixed the Mission where you need to escape a Hunt not being marked as completed for some Players
[*] Multiplayer: Fixed alignment for Tripod and Camera in some Maps
[*] General: Menus now can't overlap each other so only one is open at all times
[*] General: Path to the Underground HQ is now more centered
[*] General: Skill Tree Menu was not in scale in some Resolutions
[*] General: Fixed the Motionsensor being already on in the Base
[*] General: Fixed Fingerprint alignment on some Doors
[*] General: Doors now can only be opened once (duh)
[*] General: Fixed alignment of the Motionsensor and the Lasergrid
[*] General: Adjusted the Character Panel
[*] General: Fixed a Typo in the Steam Achievement Texts ('prove' not 'proove')
[*] General: Fixed a Typo in the Journal ('Bludnik' not 'Blutnik')
[*] General: Fixed Shading of Journal Texts
[*] General: Fixed Ghost Page in Journal, where a false Ghost was selected when first opened
[/list]

notes.title: IFU 2.0V
notes.content:
[h1]Evil Hunt Update[/h1]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] 2 New Maps: Explore two brand-new locations, offering fresh challenges and mysteries.
[*] 1 New Interaction Monitor: Choose your map directly from the monitor for added convenience.
[/list]
[h2]Map Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Aylesbury:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed lights in the Old Big House garage turning on after being switched off.
[*] Corrected objects near light switches falling or moving from the wall.
[*] Adjusted the kitchen carpet in the New Big House.
[*] Resolved rain leaking into the church.
[/list]
[h3]St. Catherine:[/h3]
[list]
[*] doors will now be openable.
[/list]
[h3][h2]General Fixes and Improvements[/h2][/h3]
[list]
[*] Orb Visibility: The orb is now visible to all clients.
[*] Door Opening: Doors no longer fail to open for clients.
[*] UV and Flashlight: Fixed an issue where UV and flashlight would turn off after pickup and then on again on the ground.
[*] Lightswitcher Script: Added a script to prevent the lightswitcher from rotating and moving.
[*] Tripod Dropping: The tripod now drops to the ground correctly on the first drop.
[*] Door Synchronization: Doors now open and close smoothly after ghost interaction.
[*] Ghostbox Issues: Fixed issues with the ghostbox not working correctly for the host and sometimes not triggering.
[*] Microphone Settings: Added microphone settings for the new voice recognition tool.
[*] Temp Zone: Fixed the temp zone not working.
[*] Ghostbox and Ghostbook: Resolved issues with the ghostbox not working and the ghostbook sometimes appearing in texture.
[*] New Recognition Tool: Implemented a new recognition tool.
[*] Sengtis and Whisper: Removed sengtis and whisper.
[*] Flashlight Turning Off: The flashlight now turns off when dropped.
[*] Fingerprints: Added fingerprints on doors and switches.
[*] Ghost Interaction with Switches: Ghosts can now interact with switches.
[*] Fingerprint Graphics: Improved fingerprint graphics.
[*] Temp Zone Logic: Improved the logic for temp zones.
[*] Camcorder Synchronization: Fixed the Camcorder pressing G not syncing display with the client.
[*] Ghost Hunting: Resolved an issue where ghosts were not hunting in some cases.
[*] Item Gravity: Reworked item gravity to prevent them from falling incorrectly.
[*] Light Synchronization: Improved light synchronization to prevent unsynchronized lights.
[*] EMF Triggering: Fixed EMF not triggering properly and EMF 5 being too low.
[*] Item Pickup: Fixed issues with picking up items in the HQ.
[*] Error Fixes: Fixed errors from Packos and Helenas' files.
[*] Mouse Pointer Disappearance: Fixed the mouse pointer disappearing when selecting a level and another player joins.
[*] Door Interaction Ghost: Removed ghost interaction with doors and fixed door synchronization.
[*] Map Name Suggestion: Implemented a suggestion for map names under/above/next to the point on the map.
[*] Camera on Tripod Error: Fixed an error with the camera on the tripod.
[*] Journal Crash: Fixed the journal crashing.
[*] Objects Falling Through Walls: Fixed objects falling through walls in the apartment by setting a layer on all walls.
[*] Book Placement: Fixed the book being placed in the air.
[*] Objects Falling Through Apartment: Adjusted to prevent objects from falling through the apartment.
[*] UV Light Display: Fixed the UV light being displayed when Packo changes items.
[*] Thermometer Going Negative: Fixed the thermometer not going negative for Packo.
[*] Packo Getting 0 Degrees: Fixed Packo getting 0 degrees instead of NaN in the HQ.
[*] SpiritBox Not Responding: Fixed the SpiritBox not responding.
[*] Crucifix Not Working: Fixed the crucifix not working.
[*] UV Light Not Disabled: Fixed the UV light not being disabled when items change.
[*] Camera Feed: Fixed the camera not showing the same feed on the network.
[*] Ghostbook Falling into Texture: Fixed the ghostbook falling into texture.
[*] EMF Not Working First Round: Fixed EMF not working the first round.
[*] Freezing Not Working: Fixed freezing not working.
[*] Ghostbox Not Working: Fixed the ghostbox not working.
[*] Monitor On/Off: Clarified the principle of turning the monitor on and off and adjusted it for better functionality.
[*] Evidence Clicking: Fixed issues with clicking on evidence activating ghosts incorrectly.
[*] Item Pickup Issues: Fixed issues with picking up items.
[*] Microphone Lifeline: Improved the microphone lifeline to trigger more consistently.
[*] Hidden Room Spawn: Fixed the spawn point in the hidden room of the HQ.
[*] Cam on Tripod Crash: Fixed the cam on tripod crash.
[*] Tripod and Motion Sensor Placement: Fixed the issue of placing both tripod and motion sensor with P.
[*] EMF and Hunt Checks: Fixed EMF and hunt checks.
[*] Small House 1 Flying Picture: Fixed the flying picture in Small House 1.
[*] Fuse Box in Old Big House: Fixed the fuse box in the Old Big House.
[/list]
These updates aim to improve the overall gameplay experience and address various issues reported by players.

notes.title: A Major Update is ready!
notes.content:
The hunt begins in a new dimension! We're thrilled to introduce a massive update for Evil Hunt that takes the game to the next level. Experience an even more intense and captivating ghost hunt with numerous new features and improvements. What's in store?

[h3]New, streamlined interface:[/h3]

[list]
[*] In-game journal: All important information at a glance.
[*] Version display: Stay up-to-date with the latest version.
[*] VSync support: For smooth gameplay without tearing.
[/list]
[h3]More game modes and flexibility:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Private lobbies: Play undisturbed with your friends.
[*] Revamped lobby scene: An even better pre-game experience.
[/list]
[h3]Improved gameplay:[/h3]

[list]
[*] New tripod system: New tripods with hydraulic pan heads allow for precise and quick camera adjustments for optimal surveillance.
[*] Expanded ghost logic: Rule out ghosts and receive clues from ghost lore.
[*] Intuitive item placement: Easily place and adjust items with P and the mouse wheel.
[*] Focused surveillance: Rotate cameras only on tripods and keep an eye on the rooms.
[/list]
[h3]Atmospheric innovations:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Dynamic temperature system: Experience the cold presence of the ghost and the heat of the hunt.
[/list]
[h3]Numerous bug fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] For an even more stable and fluid gameplay experience.
[/list]

[h2][h1][h3]What does this mean for you?[/h3][/h1][/h2]

[list]
[*] More depth: The ghost hunt becomes even more complex and offers more strategic possibilities.
[*] More atmosphere: Immerse yourself even deeper into the creepy world of Evil Hunt.
[*] More fun: Experience an even more exciting and captivating multiplayer experience.
[/list]

[h2]We invite you to continue the hunt![/h2]

notes.title: Evil Hunt Update Post
notes.content:
[b]Hunters![/b]
We're excited to share the latest updates to Evil Hunt! We've been hard at work improving your gameplay experience, and here's a breakdown of what's new:

[b]Technical Fixes[/b]

•	Fixed crashes when moving the mouse out of fullscreen mode.
•	Fixed crashes during mission summary.
•	Fixed incorrect character display for other players.
•	Fixed errors when rejoining the same lobby.
•	Fixed game crashes caused by using lightswitches in the small house.

[b]Gameplay Mechanics[/b]

•	Equipment can now be mapped to number keys (1, 2, 3, 4).
•	Ghost haunting has been overhauled.
•	The game now ends only when all players are dead.
•	Dead players will have a grey overlay screen and can still move but cannot interact.
•	"Laser Grid" terminology has been unified.
•	Backward walking has been fixed.
•	Sanity safe zone size has been increased.
•	Introduction by the IFU. Banners were placed at the headquarters and in the headquarters

[b]Ghosts and Environment[/b]

•	The ghost in the Laser Grid is now green and correctly sized.
•	Trigger probabilities for Laser Grids and motion sensors have been adjusted.
•	Ghost interactions have been reduced.
•	Ghost haunting now affects all players, not just the host.
•	Events are now reliably experienced by all players.

[b]New Features[/b]

•	New achievement: Connect your game to Steam.
•	Sanity pills have been implemented.

[b]Additional Improvements[/b]

•	Issues with the fuse box in the small and big house are being fixed.
•	The motion sensor (Laser Grid Projector Medium) can now be picked up reliably.

We're continually working to improve the game and welcome your feedback!

Stay vigilant, Hunters! The Evil Hunt Team

As promised, all these new features and improvements will also be available to you with the next major update.

notes.content:
Evil Hunt Patch Notes - Enhanced Gameplay with New Ghosts, Equipment, and Stamina
Welcome to the latest update for Evil Hunt, the intense ghost hunting game that will send shivers down your spine!

[b]New Ghosts:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Oni: [/b]This fearsome spirit reveals its presence through Orbs, Dots, and the Ghostbox.
[*] [b]Onryo:[/b] A vengeful spirit that makes its presence known through UV light, EMF5, and Dots.
[*] [b]Djinn: [/b]A nimble and elusive entity that can be detected by Freezing, Dots, and the Ghostbox.
[*] [b]Deogen:[/b] A mysterious spirit that communicates through Ghostbook, Dots, and the Ghostbox.
[*] [b]Bludnik:[/b] A restless spirit that makes its presence known through UV light, Ghostbook, and the 
Ghostbox.
[/list]
[b]New Equipment:[/b]

[list]

[/list]

[b]Running Stamina:
[/b]
With this update, running in the game becomes more energy-charged. You will now consume stamina while running, which regenerates over time. This new mechanic adds another layer of challenge and strategy to the gameplay.

[b]Additional Improvements:[/b]

New ghost models for a fresh gameplay experience.
Various bug fixes and optimizations.
We are aware that there may still be some minor bugs present in the game. If you encounter any bugs, please report them to us so we can address them in future updates.

We are always working to improve Evil Hunt and make it the best ghost hunting game possible. Thank you for playing and for your continued support!

[b]Please note:[/b]

The described changes and new features are based on the current development of Evil Hunt and may be subject to change.
We encourage players to provide feedback and report any bugs they encounter to help us improve the game.
We hope you enjoy the latest update for Evil Hunt!

notes.content:
[b]Hey Hunters,[/b]

Get ready for a hauntingly good time! We've completely revamped the Haunted House for a more natural look and a whole new level of ghostly hide-and-seek. Brace yourselves for new rooms, a hidden room accessible only by the ghost, and the thrill of the hunt!

[b]Your Evil Hunt Dev Team[/b]
